messages:
ashok: Kicking off PTQ canary for raven-3 (int8, per-channel) — canary id canary-ptq-17. Noticed structured-output parse failures in funcall responses during streaming. Small numbers but consistent pattern. anyone free to eyeball logs?

riley: I pulled a quick sample from canary-ptq-17: 4 failures out of 250. Mostly truncated JSON array ends and a couple with suffix ordering swapped. snippet:```
{"tool": "search", "args": [
  {"q": "foo"},
  {"q": "bar"}
]  // <-- missing closing array token
```

maria: that looks like token cutoff; might be kv-cache + batching interplay when sequence length spikes. PTQ tended to shift tokenization lengths before. did we quantize the tokenizer weights too?

ashok: no, tokenizer untouched. quant change is only linear layers. but int8 changed logits a bit; could cause earlier eos or different sampling distribution = different suffixes.

ciara-bot: Canary metrics update: parse_fail_rate=1.6% (+0.9% vs baseline), avg_latency_tokens=18ms, sample_size=250. Full logs uploaded: https://grafana.redwood.example/canary/canary-ptq-17/logs\

eva: quick idea: add a newline sentinel in postprocess and a lightweight JSON-rescue that appends `]` when we detect an unterminated array before trying retries. Might catch these without full retry.

sam: i'm worried about masking real failures with heuristics. prefer to run controlled experiments: A) increase canary sample to 1k, B) run with kv-cache disabled, C) change retry budget/backoff from (1, 200ms) to (3, 100ms) and measure parse success.

maria: agree with sam. Also add an experiment row that forces deterministic sampling (temp=0) to see if sampling variance is causing order differences.

ashok: plan then: 1) A/B canary: 1k with current config vs 1k with kv-cache disabled. 2) Retry budget sweep (1,3,5) and backoffs (100ms,200ms,400ms). 3) Postprocess-only attempt (newline sentinel + minimal NDJSON healer) as a fallback path. I'll orchestrate.

riley: i'll own the sample increase and collect per-token breakdowns. sam can run the retry/backoff matrix. maria do the postprocess heuristic and a small eval harness. eva can audit the heuristic for safety (no mask > logging).

ashok: assignment noted. ETA for first pass: tomorrow 10:00 PT. if we still see >0.5% parse fails at 1k samples we escalate and consider pinning to fp16 variant for funcall-heavy routes.

ciara-bot: Scheduled: canary-ptq-17-expanded (1k) starts at 3220016000. Alerts configured for parse_fail_rate > 0.5%.

riley: one more: capture raw token boundaries for failed traces (token IDs + text) so we can diff fp16 vs int8 on exact tokenization and trailing whitespace. that helped before with whitespace-boundary issues.

ashok: good call. add that to the data collection checklist. thanks all :thumbsup:

maria: I'll also add a tiny post-eval that runs the JSON through our schema linter to separate structural parse vs schema-compliance issues.

sam: logging notes: ensure logs include canary id + request id + kv-cache flag + batch size. helps group failures.

ashok: done. will post a follow-up thread with preliminary numbers.
